caption:
You stepped in to help God out. It felt like faith — so why did it quietly take the promise into your own hands? (Galatians 4:21-24 devotional)

Helping God and trusting God are not the same thing. Sarai's plan sounded devoted — "the LORD has kept me from bearing children" — but it had already stepped off the promise, and the flesh can only manufacture an Ishmael where God meant to give an Isaac. You don't have to rescue the promise; the price and the outcome are His to keep.
